# Comfy Seedream 4.0- Image Edit

Multi-modal AI model for text-to-image and image editing. Generate 2K images in under 2 seconds with natural language control. Runs on Comfy Cloud and needs Comfy Cloud partner credits.

**How it works:** The Comfy nodes form the complete template graph. Run submits the graph to Comfy Cloud and saves its outputs.

**Try this:** Change the prompt or the Load node inputs and run again to compare results.

Source: https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/blob/1ae390968e323dba24a6991d1860ded051f5a79b/templates/api_bytedance_seedream4.json (MIT). Model licenses apply separately.

data.prompt: A panoramic lens inside the space capsule is used, presenting a eye-level view that can show most of the space inside the capsule. In the frame, a monkey in a silver-white spacesuit is intently operating the buttons on the console; next to it, a giraffe, also in a spacesuit, uses its long neck to easily check the instrument panel at a high position; an elephant is securing a large experimental container with its sturdy legs, diligently conducting space experiments; a kangaroo places its joey into a specially made space baby capsule and is checking the life support system inside the capsule itself; there is also a penguin, gliding nimbly inside the capsule, responsible for delivering small experimental samples. Overall, the animals are portrayed as astronauts, creating a novel and busy space exploration scene inside the technologically advanced space capsule. Suspended in the middle of the frame is a huge three-dimensional "C" symbol with a glass-like texture, glowing. It is a smooth three-dimensional character with a metallic texture, and the metal shimmers with colorful halos, being a metal art piece that becomes the focal point of the frame.
